recipe.description: Ofc. Vale original graphical face direction: a broad high-cheeked face with a longer tapered jaw, forward chin and defined nose profile, distinct from Hale's narrower rectangular structure and Renn's broad squared face. Modest backward ear rotation makes the temple/cap junction legible. Strong neck transitions support a broad-shouldered, narrow-waisted 1.86 m uniform. Graphical morph labels establish no age, ethnicity, gender identity, family connection or backstory. Seeded palettes are unchanged.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
